title: Federal contract dollars flowing to Exponent
what: Every prime federal contract awarded to Exponent, Inc., by fiscal year and by agency, from USAspending.gov - the official public ledger of US government spending.
how: USAspending records every prime federal award. We matched awards whose recipient name is exactly Exponent (or its pre-1998 name) and summed the obligated dollars per federal fiscal year (Oct-Sep).
thesis: Two signals: (1) credibility - the Department of Defense repeatedly hiring your engineering firm is a quality stamp no marketing budget can buy; (2) the award trend recovered from the 2014-2018 trough (~$17M/yr) back to $60-74M/yr - a small but real, contractually-committed revenue stream.
caveats: Only PRIME contracts appear; subcontracts and classified work are invisible here.
Federal work is a modest slice of Exponent's ~$580M revenue - read this as a credibility anchor, not a growth driver.
The current fiscal year is incomplete by definition.
